why: A (universe 0) is Morse.IsLeviCivita.isAdInvariant: for ANY real Lie algebra L, form B and bilinear D with IsLeviCivita B D and D X X = 0: B ⁅X,Y⁆ Z = B X ⁅Y,Z⁆ — pure algebra. B: on a Lie group with a bi-invariant metric and Levi-Civita connection, (i) ⟨X_u,X_w⟩ constant, (ii) Y⟨X,Z⟩ = ⟨Y⊢X,Z⟩ + ⟨X,Y⊢Z⟩ (dirD = mfderiv), (iii) ⟨[X,Y],Z⟩ = ⟨X,[Y,Z]⟩ at every point. B ⇒ A only vacuously. A ⇒ B fails genuinely: (ii) is the derivative form of metric compatibility, which from the blind parallel-transport definition (IsCompat) needs parallel frames along curves (ODE existence) — not in the project, which takes compatibility on 𝔤 as an axiom of IsLeviCivita; (iii) also needs X ⊢ X = 0 (geodesics). Proved (#rt_check OK): (i) outright from left invariance; bridge adInv_of_A: A + (ii) + X ⊢ X = 0 + symmetry ⇒ (iii), Milnor's proof with A applied to 𝔤, the metric at 1 and D u v = (X_u ⊢ X_v)(1) (the derivative of the constant ⟨X,Z⟩ vanishes, giving IsLeviCivita's metric clause). Only LEFT invariance is used; right invariance enters only via X ⊢ X = 0.
overlap: B_to_A: 3 shared [Morse.IsLeviCivita.torsion_free, Morse.IsLeviCivita.metric, Morse.IsAdInvariant._proof_1] (projections/auxiliary). Bridges adInv_of_A and B_of_core pass #rt_check.

(The project's embedded matrix-group version of 21.1–21.3, Morse/Chapter12/GroupGeodesics.lean, e.g. IsMatrixGroup.curvOp_eq_curv_halfLie, is not part of this item.) B quantifies over abstract Lie groups with a Mathlib RiemannianBundle, not over Bridge.Sub.
